introduction:
The Ration Card in Karnataka is issued by the Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Government of Karnataka. Generally, new applications are paused; however, the government opens a special application window for Medical Emergencies (ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ತುರ್ತು) to obtain a Priority Household (PHH / BPL) Ration Card.

This process is specifically designed for urgent medical needs and requires biometric verification via a fingerprint scanner connected to a desktop/laptop, bypassing the traditional Aadhaar OTP login.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Service: New Ration Card Application (Priority Household - PHH / BPL) under Medical Emergency (ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ತುರ್ತು).
  • Special Window: Used specifically when general BPL/PHH applications are paused.
  • Hardware Requirement: A biometric fingerprint scanner (e.g., Mantra MFS100) connected to a laptop/desktop is **mandatory** (bypasses Aadhaar OTP login).
  • Head of Family: The eldest female member is typically designated as the Head of the Family (HoF).
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Ration Card (Medical Emergency)

Identity & Biometrics
  • Aadhaar Cards: Original Aadhaar numbers for all family members.
  • Biometrics: Fingerprint scans via Mantra device for all members above 6 years.
  • Birth Certificate: Required only for children below 6 years (no biometrics captured).
Certificates (RD Numbers)
  • Income Certificate: RD Number of a valid Income Certificate (Mandatory).
  • Caste Certificate: RD Number of a valid Caste Certificate (Optional, but recommended).
Medical Proofs
  • Doctor's recommendation letter, hospital bills, and surgery/treatment proofs.
  • Format: Must be scanned and merged into a single PDF file (size strictly under 1 MB).
onlineApplication:
Online Process via Ahara Portal

  1. Access Portal: Go to ahara.karnataka.gov.in and click on e-Services (ಇ-ಸೇವೆಗಳು).
  2. Select Region: Click on Public Services (ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಬಳಕೆ) and choose your relevant server division (Bengaluru, Mysuru, or Kalaburagi).
  3. Start Application: Click on New Ration card (ಹೊಸ ಪಡಿತರ ಚೀಟಿ), select your language, and click New Ration Card Request.
  4. Select Card Type: Choose PHH (Priority Household).
  5. Eligibility Checklist: A list of exclusion criteria will appear (e.g., Govt employee, paying income tax, owning 4-wheelers, large land). Select that you do not fall under these disqualifications to proceed. Select "No" when asked if you have applied for a BPL card before.
  6. Select Special Category: Check the Special box and select Medical Emergency.
  7. HoF Authentication: Enter the HoF's Aadhaar and mobile number. Select the fingerprint scanner option, capture the fingerprint using the Mantra device, and verify. Aadhaar details will be fetched automatically.
  8. Verify Certificates: Enter your Income Certificate RD number and click 'Verify'. Do the same for the Caste Certificate. Confirm the fetched details are correct.
  9. Add Family Members:
    - Click Add (ಸೇರಿಸಿ).
    - For members above 6 years: Enter Aadhaar, mobile number, and capture fingerprint via the biometric device.
    - For children under 6 years: Biometric is not needed; enter their Aadhaar and Birth Certificate Number.
    - Assign the relationship to the HoF, occupation, income, and physical disability status for each member.
  10. Medical Details & Upload: Enter the patient's hospital details: Doctor's Name, Hospital Name, District, Taluk, and select the specific illness/surgery from the dropdown. Upload the merged Medical PDF file (Under 1 MB).
  11. Address & Ration Shop: Fill in your ward/village details. Select your nearest Fair Price Shop (FPS) from the dropdown list.
  12. Submit: Review all details and click Submit. An acknowledgement page will be generated. Save this as a PDF and print two copies.
offlineApplication:
Mandatory Offline Verification Step

After submitting the online application, you must complete this offline step immediately:

  1. Gather one printed copy of the online Acknowledgement slip.
  2. Attach physical copies of all family members' Aadhaar cards, the Income Certificate, Caste Certificate, and all the Medical Documents you uploaded.
  3. Submit this physical file to your local Food Inspector / Tahsildar's office (Food and Civil Supplies Department) for manual verification.
afterApplying:
After Applying — What Next?

  • Verification: The Food Inspector will verify the medical emergency claim and the eligibility criteria based on your physical submission.
  • Fast-Track Approval: Because this is a "Medical Emergency" application, the approval process is prioritized. Upon successful verification by the DD office, the Ration Card is usually approved and issued within 3 to 4 days.
